title: Dark of the Woods / Soft Come the Dragons
author: Dean R. Koontz
note: conf=0.9; This ebook reproduces the 1970 Ace Double (Ace #13793), a dos-à-dos volume pairing Koontz's short novel "Dark of the Woods" with his story collection "Soft Come the Dragons" (the file's metadata mis-renders it as "Soft Comes the Dragons"). Both works are independent early SF by Koontz; neither belongs to a numbered fiction series. "Ace Double" is a publisher/publication series (catalog number 13793), not a story series, so no series is assigned.
